Good to know

Info

Sizes, fabric, care and delivery. Still unsure? Ask us on WhatsApp.

How do I order?+
Open any tee, pick your size and tap “Order on WhatsApp”. A message with the tee, size and price is filled in for you. Send it and we'll reply to confirm your order.
How much does a tee cost?+
Every Aurafied tee is R450.
Which sizes do you have?+
Sizes S, M, L, XL, XXL. Our tees have a relaxed, boxy fit, so take your normal size for an oversized look, or one size down for a closer fit.
What are the tees made of?+
Premium heavyweight 260 GSM cotton with high quality prints made to last.
How should I wash my tee?+
Turn it inside out, wash cold, and hang it to dry. Don't iron directly on the print. This keeps the print looking new for longer.
Do you deliver to my area?+
Yes, we deliver nationwide across South Africa. Ask us on WhatsApp for the delivery cost and time to your area.
How do I pay?+
We'll share the payment details with you on WhatsApp when we confirm your order.

About the brand

Engineered to wear designer

Aurafied Apparel is streetwear for people who carry their own energy. Every piece starts with a bold idea — a chrome melt, a smoke-filled silhouette, a stitched crown of stars — and lands on a heavyweight tee built to last.

We use premium 260 GSM cotton in a relaxed, boxy fit, with high quality prints that hold up wash after wash. Order on WhatsApp and we deliver anywhere in South Africa.
